name: Global 3DGS with Progressively Growing
definition: A sequential reconstruction method that learns a global 3D Gaussian model by progressively adding frames, using estimated relative poses to update the scene representation and densifying Gaussians to cover new views.
summary: Global 3DGS with Progressively Growing is a sequential reconstruction method that incrementally integrates frames to avoid noisy pose error accumulation, ensuring continuous coverage of unobserved regions.
